subject: Request: Article 30 extract & evidence for subprocessor transfer during provider migration
messages:
From: ClearBank Legal <legal@clearbank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Aisha Raman <aisha@thirdbridge.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Article 30 extract & evidence for subprocessor change during migration

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our privacy team: we understand Redwood is planning a migration of a portion of inference routing to a new infrastructure provider next month, and we need two things to close our review this week:

1) An Article 30 extract that shows processing activities for the ClearBank account (data categories, purposes, transfers, subprocessors in scope).
2) Evidence of the subprocessor transfer plan and the specific controls used during the migration (chain-of-custody for files, any escrow or interim storage, and KMS access logs for the migration window).

Can you provide those items by EOD Wednesday? If you have a DPA addendum or an updated subprocessor list reflecting the migration, please include drafts. We may need a short DPIA note if the migration changes data residency or introduces new processing categories.

Thanks — this is timing-sensitive for our regulator-driven onboarding.

Best,
Ella Peterson
Head of Legal Operations
ClearBank

--
Attachment: request-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: ClearBank Legal <legal@clearbank.com>
Cc: Aisha Raman <aisha@thirdbridge.com>, logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-05-04T10:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Article 30 extract & evidence for subprocessor change during migration

Ella —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can get you everything on the list; summary below and an ETA for each deliverable.

Deliverables and ETA:
- Article 30 extract (clean PDF): by 2028-05-04 17:00 PDT — includes table of processing activities scoped to ClearBank (data categories, purposes, recipients).
- Subprocessor transfer log (plain text export + change diff): by 2028-05-04 17:00 PDT — shows prior and post-migration inventory with timestamps.
- KMS access logs (CSV, redacted as needed): preliminary export by 2028-05-04 15:00 PDT; full logset and explanation by Friday if you need deeper traces.
- Draft DPA addendum that covers migration-specific commitments (retention, rollback, escrow): attached (dpa-addendum-draft.docx).
- Short DPIA note outlining risk mitigation for the migration: will follow Thursday morning.

Notes on controls during migration:
- Files are staged to an encrypted, access-restricted escrow bucket for a 72-hour window during cutover. Only the migration service account (audited) and a single operator role may access the escrow bucket; we will provide audit traces.
- We will not change primary data residency for ClearBank during the migration; routing changes are layer-level and controlled by policy. Any temporary storage during cutover is within our approved EU/US regions depending on account configuration.

Attaching the Article 30 extract and the subprocessor transfer log shortly. 

If you need a defensive call to walk through the logs, Logan and Kimberly are available today afternoon.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: article30-extract.pdf (pdf); subprocessor-transfer-log.txt (txt)
From: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com

Marissa — quick follow-up to confirm two technical artifacts ClearBank asked for that we should prioritize:  

1) KMS key-use summary for the migration window (UTC timestamps + operator principal) — we'll redact principals to role-level if needed, but include request/response hashes so they can verify integrity.
2) A short chain-of-custody note (bullet list + SHA256 of staged archive) showing how we put data into escrow, who touched it, and when.

I exported a filtered KMS access log and a preliminary CSV (kms-access-logs.csv). Putting both in the same Drive folder as the Article 30 extract. Kimberly — can you confirm the draft DPA addendum language around rollback and escrow liability? I added a short clause to protect the customer while we complete the migration.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Director, Cloud Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks — that timeline works. Two quick asks before we close: 

1) Please upload the Article 30 extract and the CSV logs to a shared drive; we will pull them into our privacy portal. Can you paste the Drive link and a DocuSign envelope for the DPA addendum?
2) For the DPIA note, can Redwood explicitly state whether the migration introduces any new recipients outside the EEA/US for ClearBank data? Our regulator flagged any changes in recipients across borders.

If both items are clear and the logs match the hashes in your chain-of-custody note, we can mark the onboarding step as complete.
